name: Ray Lee Hunt
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (1996-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Wikidata (2025)
forbes_bio: Ray Lee Hunt is the wealthiest of legendary oil wildcatter H.L. Hunt's 15 children.
He is the chairman emeritus of Hunt Consolidated, an oil and gas, real estate and investing conglomerate.
His Hunt Oil, once one of the largest privately held oil firms in the U.S., owns stakes in natural gas fields and a gas liquefaction plant in Peru.
Hunt Oil was one of the first to land an exploration deal in Iraq's Kurdistan region after the fall of Saddam Hussein.
His son, Hunter Hunt, serves as CEO of Hunt Consolidated's energy and infrastructure businesses and is his heir apparent.
forbes_facts: Hunt's half-brothers, W. Herbert (d. 2024) and Nelson Bunker Hunt (d. 2014), once tried to corner the silver market.
Hunt's father is said to have been a major inspiration for the J.R. Ewing character on the TV show "Dallas."

name: Alceu Elias Feldmann
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2019-2025); Hurun Global (2020-2026)
forbes_bio: Alceu Elias Feldmann is the founder of Fertipar, a Brazilian fertilizer giant with revenue of $3.9 billion in 2021.
He and his three children have retained private control of Fertipar's shares.
Feldmann, armed with a degree in agricultural engineering from the Federal University of Parana, founded the company in 1980.
Feldmann still serves as chairman and president of Fertipar, which operates a dozen companies across Brazil
Feldmann's older son, who shares his name, is a professional race car driver with 13 seasons in Stock Car Brasil.

name: Jyoti Bansal
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Hurun India (2018-2019); Hurun Unicorn founders (2021-2026)
forbes_bio: Jyoti Bansal is the founder and CEO of software delivery company Harness, which uses AI agents to automate the manual labor of making sure code is secure and compliant with regulations.
Bansal grew up helping his dad with his farming machinery business in a small town in India's Rajasthan state, before testing into Delhi's Indian Institute of Technology for computer engineering.
He immigrated to the U.S. at age 21 and worked as an engineer at a handful of startups in Silicon Valley for seven years on an H1-B visa before getting his green card.
Bansal sold his first company, AppDynamics, which diagnoses and troubleshoots software anomalies, to Cisco for $3.7 billion in 2017. He founded Harness soon after.
Harness raised a $240 million Series E funding round from Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Institutional Venture Partners and Menlo Ventures at a $5.5 billion valuation in late 2025.
forbes_facts: Bansal fell in love with entrepreneurship after he met billionaire Bill Gates, who visited Delhi's Indian Institute of Technology when Bansal was a student.
Bansal has hiked Machu Picchu, trekked the Himalayas and gone on multiple African safaris.

name: Piotr Dabkowski
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Hurun Global (2026); Hurun Global U40 (2026); Hurun Unicorn founders (2025-2026)
forbes_bio: Piotr Dabkowski is cofounder of Warsaw and London-based AI voice agent startup ElevenLabs.
Private investors valued the company at $6.6 billion in October 2025. Dabkowski and his billionaire cofounder Mateusz "Mati" Staniszewski each own an estimated 15% stake.
The high school friends from Poland teamed up to experiment with artificial intelligence while Staniszewski was working at Palantir and Dabkowski was working at Google.
The pair pooled their savings and quit their jobs to work full-time on ElevenLabs in 2022.
The firm has no traditional titles, but Staniszewski acts as CEO and Dabkowski acts as research head.

name: KR Sridhar
forbes_bio: KR Sridhar is founder, chairman and CEO of fuel cell energy systems manufacturer Bloom Energy.
He launched the company in 2001 and took it public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2018.
Sridhar owns nearly 2% of the $2 billion (2025 revenue) firm.
Sridhar led a team at NASA developing oxygen-generation technology before founding Bloom Energy.
Born in India, Sridhar earned his master's in nuclear engineering and PhD in mechanical engineering from the University of Illinois, Urbana-Champaign.
